status: Post-hoc uncertainty analysis after inspection of robustness point estimates; not prospective preregistration.

cohort.name: NHANES 2017-March 2020 Pre-Pandemic Temporal Evaluation Cohort
cohort.selection_policy: Unweighted temporal holdout, frozen participant order matching temporal_ml_ready.csv

auroc.interpretation: Positive values indicate performance deterioration (loss in discrimination).

brier.interpretation: Positive values indicate performance deterioration (increase in probability error).

interpretation.positive: BioNutriGPT deteriorated more under stress than comparator.
interpretation.negative: BioNutriGPT deteriorated less under stress than comparator (greater relative robustness).
interpretation.zero_inclusion: Interval containing zero indicates insufficient evidence of difference in deterioration, not proof of equivalence.

between_model_contrast_definition.reporting_rule: Report absolute stressed performance alongside deterioration. A model can deteriorate less simply because its baseline performance was lower.

bootstrap_specification.pairing_contract: Identical resample index matrix shared across all models, scenarios, and outcomes to preserve paired differences.
bootstrap_specification.invalid_replicate_policy: Record valid replicate count. Do not redraw invalid one-class samples to conceal them. Mark undefined if any.

multiplicity_policy: All confidence intervals are exploratory and pointwise. No overall superiority claim is permitted from isolated unadjusted intervals.
scope_and_limitations: Conditional on frozen fitted models, the observed temporal cohort (N=7,004), and realized scenario perturbations.
Does not incorporate model-training variability (random initialization / seed variance across fits).
Does not incorporate general variability across all possible perturbation realizations.
Does not incorporate NHANES complex survey design (ordinary participant bootstrap, unweighted).
Engineering stress scenarios are coordinate-wise sensitivity tests, not validated device, recall, or physiological error distributions.
Does not establish external Indian clinical validity, clinical safety, or disease risk reduction.
